text.p: Falls in two blue chip hotel and banking stocks helped push the Stock Exchange of Mauritius index SEMDEX down 1.66 points on Wednesday to 364.26, bourse officials said.
Volume rose to 6.79 million rupees on 255,082 shares from 1.59 million rupees on 76,070 shares on last Monday.
Sun Resorts eased 30 cents to 45.00 rupees on 1,325 shares, New Mauritius Hotels was stable at 36.80 rupees on 100,000 shares and Grand Baie Hotel lost 1.00 rupee to 50.00 rupees but was not quoted.
Mauritius Commercial Bank fell 50 cents to 86.50 rupees on 10,200 shares and State Bank of Mauritius was unchanged to 12.00 rupees on 33,300 shares.

British American Insurance climbed 10 cents to 8.80 rupees on 37,311 shares, Swan fell 50 cents to 46.00 rupees on 1,000 shares and Mauritius Union Assurance gained 20 cents to 31.00 rupees on 2,667 shares.
Commerce-based Rogers was stable at 90.00 rupees on 509 shares and Ireland Blyth Ltd slipped 30 cents to 15.40 rupees, but was unquoted. Shell gained 10 cents to 20.30 rupees on 6,900 shares.
In the sugar sector, Mon Tresor Mon Desert was stable at 38.50 rupees on 10,000 shares and Mon Desert Alma eased 50 cents to 71.00 rupees on 200 shares.

In the investment sector, Consolidated Investment Trust fell five cents to 8.60 rupees on 11,296 shares, Fincorp was 2.50 rupees lower to 62.00 rupees on 1,600 shares and United Docks lost 20 cents to 35.80 rupees on 2,947 shares.
Air Mauritius was unchanged at 31.20 rupees unquoted.
